edition.en: Chapter 1 of the Zhuangzi, complete, as given on Chinese Wikisource; the inline notes on variant readings and the editorial brackets are removed.
edition.zh: 《庄子》第一篇全文，据维基文库；删去行内异文注与校勘括号。

basis.en: Classical Chinese text of the Warring States period; the author died about 286 BCE.
basis.zh: 战国古典文本，作者约卒于公元前 286 年。

note.en: The opening chapter of the Zhuangzi, and its most famous: a fish that becomes a bird, a quail that laughs at it, and a useless tree that no axe will touch. It is shelved complete. Notice how the argument keeps changing scale, from the ninety thousand miles of the Peng to a cup of water poured into a hollow in the floor.
note.zh: 《庄子》开篇，也是最有名的一篇：化而为鸟的鱼，笑它的斥鴳，还有斧斤不加的无用之树。全文上架。留意论说不断变换尺度：从鹏的九万里，到倒在坳堂上的一杯水。

excerpt.orig: 北冥有魚，其名爲鯤。鯤之大，不知其幾千里也，化而爲鳥，其名爲鵬。
excerpt.en: In the northern darkness there is a fish whose name is Kun. The Kun is so large that no one knows how many thousand miles it measures. It changes and becomes a bird whose name is Peng.
excerpt.zh: 北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也，化而为鸟，其名为鹏。
